settlements.name: Rotterdam Orbital
settlements.identity: One of Earth's largest bulk orbital transfer complexes; efficient, regulated and relentlessly busy.
notable: oldest sections repeatedly rebuilt around active docks

settlements.name: New Houston
settlements.identity: Roosevelt's best-known shipbuilding city and namesake of the system's common name.

settlements.name: Greenline
settlements.identity: Rail, grain, refrigeration and machinery hub serving enormous surrounding agricultural districts.

settlements.name: Keelward
settlements.identity: Surface support city beneath the system's largest orbital construction zone.

settlements.name: Twelve
settlements.identity: Old mining habitat whose numeric construction designation became its permanent name.

settlements.name: Lowell
settlements.identity: Dense university and laboratory city where scientific cargo can be worth more than the ship carrying it.

settlements.name: Crosswater
settlements.identity: Mixed Vey-Human city spanning natural volcanic islands and floating districts.

settlements.name: Anchor Seven
settlements.identity: Largest permanent platform cluster on Tidemark and the closest thing the planet has to a capital.

settlements.name: Deepworks
settlements.identity: Factory city kilometers below the surface, organized around process heat and freight shafts.

settlements.name: Old Ring
settlements.identity: The surviving core of the original fuel depot, now cheap, crowded and culturally central.
notable: original fuel-control room preserved behind a restaurant

settlements.name: Hopewell
settlements.identity: Primary Talos settlement; construction camp, mining headquarters and freight jam simultaneously.

settlements.name: Crossroads
settlements.identity: Oldest connected cluster of the accidental town.

settlements.name: Beacon
settlements.identity: The surface settlement most outward-bound crews mean when they say Lastlight.
